reason: Every opcode is plain NMOS 6502 (STA/LDA abs and abs,Y, CLC, ADC #, BCC, INC abs, ASL A, TAX/TAY/TXA/TYA, LDY #, DEY, BPL, RTS): valid on the 65SC12, no decimal mode. Recount, BEQ excluded: old set-up 47 (BCC taken; 52 when the digit's source crosses a page) + loop 32*14-1 = 447; new set-up 81 (BCC taken; 86 when screen low >= &F0) + loop 16*23-1 = 367. Net -46 in the common case. STA abs,Y costs 5 every time on the 65C02, so the destination's crossings cost nothing either way. Source crossings: each half's base + Y (Y 0..15) can cross a page only where the old base + j did (at most one boundary inside 32 bytes), so new crossings <= old. Bytes: old 46, new 77, so +31 (claim -31 saved, correct). BEQ by_cell is +&4D (in range), BPL fast_row is -15. Self-modified operands: fast_src/fast_dst +1/+2 and lv_u2_src/lv_u2_dst +1/+2 are written only in this routine, at the right offsets (listing: STA &940C/&940D for the STA &4010,Y at &940B; &9409/&940A for the LDA at &9408). The page &7F (wrap) case still goes to by_cell, so dst+16's INC never passes &7F. The src arithmetic (Y = HI+bit3; ADC #0 takes the low carry and leaves C = 0; ADC #HI(ld+16)-HI(ld) after ADC #LO(ld+16)) gives ld+32d and ld+32d+16 exactly. On exit A = digit byte 0, X and Y=&FF, N=1 and Z=0 as before; C/V differ, but both callers do LDY ren_k / LDX back next and read no flags. The slide: everything after it in bank 4 (lives_digits &9444->&9463, write_column, the rest of the renderer, sprite_columns, compiled_table, sprite_straight) moves up 31 bytes. Checked by building both in scratch (DEBUG_LIVES bench flags; the baseline's game files are identical to build/strykers-debug_lives.ssd) and running pcprof as grind_config does. seed 1, 1500 passes: render 23430 -> 23394 a pass, logic 9440 -> 9442. RIGHT from 50, 600 passes: 28406 -> 28351, logic 10255 -> 10254. write_column 3411 -> 3410. The 31-byte slide therefore costs nothing measurable, and the saving matches 46 x executions.
